notes.title: Playtest Version 3.0
notes.notes:
Patch Notes: Playtest Version 3.0

Major Gameplay Update

Free-Form Movement: Movement in battle has transitioned from grid-based to free-form, offering a more fluid and dynamic tactical experience. Note: Attacks, enemy placement, and magic remain grid-based for now.
Auto-Wait Functionality: Characters will now automatically wait when they run out of both movement and actions, streamlining turn flow.


UI and UX Improvements

Menu Pacing Enhancements: Improved menu behavior to maintain better pacing during battle and decision-making phases.


Bug Fixes

Various bugs have been resolved to improve overall game stability and gameplay consistency.


We're excited to bring you this major evolution in the battle system! As always, your feedback is incredibly valuable. Let us know what you think of Playtest Version 3.0!

notes.title: Patch Notes: Playtest Version 2.6
notes.notes:
Patch Notes: Playtest Version 2.6

Visual and UI Improvements

Animation Updates: Smoothed and improved transitions for all animations, making gameplay more fluid and immersive.
Font Update: Refreshed in-game fonts for better readability and a cleaner look.
Damage Indicator Redesign: Redesigned the damage indicator when selecting a target to make combat feedback clearer.
Tutorial Glyph Updates: Updated glyphs shown in tutorials to work better with mouse and keyboard setups.


Gameplay Improvements

Default Mouse Control Remapping: Remapped default mouse controls to be more intuitive and user-friendly during gameplay.


Bug Fixes

Fixed an issue where pausing the game during a tutorial could cause the tutorial to break.
Resolved unintended behavior when clicking other menu options during move, attack, or magic selection phases in battle.


Your feedback is incredibly helpful as we continue refining the game experience. Thank you for testing Playtest Version 2.6!

notes.title: Patch Notes: Playtest Version 2.5
notes.notes:
Patch Notes: Playtest Version 2.5

New Features

Blocking Mechanic: Introduced a new blocking mechanic where players or enemies can block an attack by pressing the same button as the attacker within a very tight timeframe, determined by the Physical Evasion stat. Note: The mechanic is still in progress, and animations for blocking are being smoothed out.


Gameplay Improvements

Mouse and Keyboard Controls: Improved functionality for smoother and more responsive input handling.
Glyph Updates: Enhanced glyphs for mouse and keyboard controls for better visual clarity and consistency.
Animation Updates: Smoothed animations across the game for a more polished and immersive experience.


Bug Fixes

Resolved an issue where character positions could reset unexpectedly.
Improved the registration of characters in the battle start area for more reliable setup.
Updated spell markers to ensure they function correctly.


Known Bugs

Some spell markers remain visible after a character dies.
Enemies occasionally stop pursuing players on certain squares.
Enemy stats are not fully displayed at wave start.
Warcart pictures need to update based on the character using it.


Coming Soon

Spell Tree: A system for progressively learning new spells.
Title Unlock System: Unlock and collect titles to show off your achievements.


Thank you for testing Playtest Version 2.5! Your feedback helps us improve the game. Let us know what you think of these changes!

notes.title: Patch Notes: Playtest Version 2.4
notes.notes:
Patch Notes: Playtest Version 2.4

New Features

New Battle Mechanic: Introduced a new melee fighting system that displays on-screen possible combo buttons and provides real-time feedback during combat, adding depth and strategy to melee encounters.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45336900/a53622d3a483d05c8bb4d708755cd1e1e96b410d.png
Gameplay Improvements

Smoothed Battle Animations: Refined and polished battle animations for a more fluid and immersive combat experience.
Unique Weapon Animations: Created distinct animations for each weapon type, adding variety and personality to combat styles.


Bug Fixes

Spells: Resolved various issues with spell casting and effects to ensure consistent functionality.
Elemental Map: Fixed bugs related to the elemental map for more accurate and intuitive gameplay.
Weather Effects: Corrected visual and functional bugs affecting weather systems for improved immersion.
Interactions: Addressed interaction-related bugs to enhance gameplay reliability and smoothness.


We value your feedback! Let us know your thoughts on the new features and improvements in Playtest Version 2.4. Thank you for testing and helping us refine the game!

notes.title: Patch Notes: Playtest Version 2.3
notes.notes:
Patch Notes: Playtest Version 2.3

Audio Updates

Placeholder Sounds: Added placeholder sounds to enhance audio feedback and overall game immersion.
Volume Control: Introduced a volume control option on the main menu, allowing players to adjust audio settings easily.


Technical Updates

Bug Fixes: Resolved small bugs affecting rain effects for improved visual consistency.


We’re excited to hear your feedback! Let us know your thoughts on the latest improvements in Playtest Version 2.3. Thank you for your support!

notes.title: Patch Notes: Playtest Version 2.2
notes.notes:
Patch Notes: Playtest Version 2.2

Gameplay Improvements

Weapon Trail Effects: Added dynamic weapon trail effects for more visually engaging combat sequences.
Hit Stop Effects: Introduced hit stop effects to enhance the impact and feedback of attacks.
Cleaner Attack Animations: Smoothed out attack animations for a more polished and immersive combat experience.
Improved Inverse Kinematics: Upgraded inverse kinematics for weapon attacks to ensure better character movement and interaction.


Technical Updates

Bug Fixes: Corrected several minor bugs to improve overall game stability.
Code Optimization: Optimized game code for better performance and smoother gameplay.


Your input is invaluable! Let us know what you think of these updates as we refine the game further. Thank you for testing Playtest Version 2.2!

notes.title: Patch Notes: Version 2.1
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45336900/461f8db4d6c6c9b0036116280c83fe9c19999518.pngPatch Notes: Version 2.1

Gameplay Improvements

Hit Markers Update: Improved hit markers for better combat clarity and feedback during battles.
Level-Up Notifications: Added a new notification system to highlight when characters level up, enhancing progression visibility.


Tutorial Expansion

Updated Translations: Improved and expanded translations for the tutorial to ensure a smoother onboarding experience for players in different languages.


Your feedback helps us shape the future of the game! Let us know your thoughts on Version 2.1. Thank you for your continued support!

notes.title: Patch Notes: Playtest v2.1
notes.notes:
Patch Notes: Playtest v2.1

Bug Fixes

Spell Status Bug: Resolved an issue where spells that result in physical attacks incorrectly applied statuses.


New Features

Hit Markers: Added hit markers to provide clearer feedback during combat.
Unpause Feature: You can now unpause the game by pressing the Start button while in the pause menu.


Improvements

Character Recognition: Improved recognition of characters in the starting box to ensure smoother setup during gameplay.
Balancing Adjustments: Adjusted various gameplay elements to improve overall balance and ensure fairer battles.


We appreciate your continued support and feedback. Dive into Playtest v2.1 and let us know what you think!

notes.title: Patch Notes: Playtest V2.0
notes.notes:
Patch Notes: Playtest v2.0

New Content

New Characters: Added 7 new characters to the roster, expanding your tactical options and team-building possibilities.  4 new enemies and 3 new allies.


Gameplay Improvements

Battle System Enhancements: Smoothed out animations and mechanics for attacking, casting spells, movement, and nearly every aspect of combat for a more fluid experience.
Spell and Attack Rebalancing: Rebalanced spells and attacks to improve gameplay dynamics. Try out Rod spells to see some major changes!


Visual Updates

Shader Reworks: Reworked sky and character shaders to improve visual fidelity and create a more immersive atmosphere.


Tutorial Expansion

Tutorial Updates: Expanded the tutorial to cover more gameplay mechanics and improve player onboarding.


Your feedback is crucial! Let us know your thoughts and suggestions as you explore the exciting updates in Playtest v2.0. Thank you for testing!

notes.title: Patch Notes: Playtest v1.3
notes.notes:
Patch Notes: Playtest v1.3

New Features

Basic Mouse and Keyboard Support: Introduced foundational support for mouse and keyboard input, enhancing accessibility and control options.
Rotating Quests: Added rotating quests to track Wave targets, bringing dynamic objectives to gameplay.


Changes

Character Stats Page: Updated the War Cart’s character stats page to include a preview of equipped items, giving players better insight into their loadout.
Main Menu Enhancements: Expanded the main menu with the following additions:

Control Options

More feedback submission options

A Quit button for quicker exits


Tutorial Expansion

Tutorial Updates: The tutorial has been expanded to cover more gameplay mechanics. This is still a work in progress, and further iterations will follow.


We value your feedback! Please share any bugs or suggestions to help us refine Playtest v1.3. Thank you for participating!

notes.title: Patch Notes: December 15, 2024
notes.notes:
Patch Notes: December 15, 2024

New Additions

Warcart Menu Tutorial: A small tutorial has been added to introduce players to the Warcart menu. This is still a work in progress, so feedback is welcome!


Changes

Quest Translations: Updated translations for quests to improve clarity and localization.
Equipment Menu: The equipment menu has been updated to prevent the [Left] input from exiting the menu unintentionally.
Battle Waypoint Quest Reward: Updated the reward for the "Battle Waypoint" tutorial quest.


Bug Fixes

Weapon Swap Animations: Improved animations for weapon swapping, ensuring cleaner transitions when swapping weapons.
Double Weapon Bug: Resolved an issue where Kael could appear to wield double weapons during weapon swaps.


We appreciate your continued feedback and support. Please report any bugs or suggestions to our Discord or community page.

notes.title: Patch Notes: Playtest v1.2
notes.notes:
Patch Notes: Playtest v1.2

New Features

Expanded Quest System: The quest system has been enhanced to support additional quest types and improve user experience.
New Quest Added: A brand-new quest has been introduced.  It will be provided each time you start the game and give you new rewards. 


Changes

Inventory Reset on Restart: Inventory is now cleared when restarting the application to ensure a fresh playtest experience.


Optimizations

Application Loading: Optimized the loading process, reducing startup times and improving overall performance.


Bug Fixes

Quest Rewards: Resolved issues with quest rewards not being correctly awarded upon completion.


We value your feedback! Please report any bugs or suggestions to our Discord (link in Library). Thank you for playtesting!
